messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: AUTOPAGE -> PagerDuty on-call: silent heartbeat from gpu-node-47. kubelet status: NotReady. Autopage reason: 'node-heartbeat-lost'
pagerduty: PagerDuty: INC-2026-3456 created and routed to emma (primary on-call). Escalation policy: infra-hw -> sms.
emma: ack — I'm taking it. pulling serial console and node state now.
emma: quick check: kubelet is NotReady, kube-proxy flapping. trying to ssh/router — no response. serial attached via console but BMC seems flaky.
sanjay: standing by as secondary. if it's kernel-level we should involve hw team early.
emma: serial snippet shows repeated machine-checks then a kernel panic with stack traces. copying small excerpt below:
```
[    10.123456] kernel: Machine check events logged
[    10.123457] kernel: mce: [Hardware Error]: CPU 1: Machine Check: 0 Bank 4: b2000000000700
[    10.123458] kernel: kernel panic - not syncing: Machine check: CPU exception
[    10.123459] ---[ end trace 9d1c5f3f6a ]---
```
emma: also seeing NVMe errors reported right before the panic — controller reset attempts.
emma: ran `kubectl get nodes` — output: 
```
NAME           STATUS     ROLES   AGE
gpu-node-47    NotReady   gpu     12d
```
kai: any immediate customer-facing impact? which services were on that node?
emma: two model-serving pods were scheduled there: r1-model-3 and r2-encoder-7. They failed over; autoscaler rescheduled to other nodes but we saw a spike in errors while they restarted.
emma: observable spike: model-serving 5xx errors + request queueing ~04:12-04:16 UTC. error budget breach for one route but auto-healed within ~6m.
olivia: tagging and notifying account teams: acme-vision and nova-audio are on the incident list. starting outreach.
sanjay: runbook check: if serial shows MCE and BMC is unreachable, try graceful drain if possible, then escalate to hardware for RMA. prefer a remote power-cycle via IPMI before RMA.
emma: attempted `ipmitool -I lanplus -H 10.12.12.47 -U admin chassis power cycle` — no response from BMC. ipmi timed out.
ops-runbook-bot: Runbook step: MCE detected + BMC unreachable -> escalate to hw-oncall, capture serial and journal, cordon node, avoid auto-recreate on same rack if possible. (link: https://redwood.runbooks/mce-rma)
emma: paging hw-oncall now. @hw-oncall please triage rack-12B node gpu-node-47.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Escalation triggered to hw-oncall via sms and call.
sanjay: switching to incident mode. emma, collect dmesg, journalctl -k and any serial capture. put artifacts into /tmp/inc-5187654321. I'll create the incident task in jira.
emma: uploading logs to /tmp/inc-5187654321: serial.log, journal-k.log, ipmi-attempts.log.
```
# sample journalctl -k snippet
Apr 12 04:11:20 gpu-node-47 kernel: nvme nvme0: ctrl 0000:3b:00.0 reset controller error
Apr 12 04:11:21 gpu-node-47 kernel: kernel: Machine check: 0 Bank 4: b2000000000700
```
emma: impact summary so far: acme-vision saw 1 pipeline fail transiently, nova-audio experienced increased tail latency, internal batch jobs had 3 pods evicted. Estimated customers affected: 2 Dedicated customers degraded briefly.
olivia: notifying CS/AEs now with the short summary and ETA for next update in 30m.
kai: are we at risk of an evacuation cascade on rack-12B? can scheduler shove pods onto other racks without overloading them?
sanjay: temporary mitigation: cordon the node and set cluster autoscaler to prefer other racks. also add a soft routing rule to avoid rack-12B for new placements until hw confirms.
emma: cordon executed: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-47` — node marked unschedulable.
emma: drain started with `kubectl drain gpu-node-47 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60` — most pods evicted/rescheduled, a few stuck on local storage.
ops-runbook-bot: Note: record PV detach times and controller fail counts in the incident ticket.
emma: hw-oncall responded: BMC unreachable over network; onsite tech will try KVM reset and power-cycle. RMA queued if that fails. ETA for onsite attempt: 30m.
hw-oncall: acknowledged — onsite tech alerted and en route to rack 12B. will attempt BMC cable reseat and power-cycle first.
emma: leaving a handoff: I will hand primary on-call to olivia for communications at 06:20 UTC, and remain available for technical follow-up.
olivia: taking over comms. i'll post update to status page and ping AEs after onsite attempt completes.
sanjay: postmortem owner assigned: santiago. severity set to P2. ticket created: RDW-INC-2026-3456.
emma: final ops note for now: node quarantined, autoscaler rebalanced, hw engaged, RMA fallback scheduled. monitoring for other silent-heartbeats in the rack. :white_check_mark:
notes: autopage -> hw escalation; includes serial logs and customer impact summary
